output.title: Spacious 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached House with South-Facing Garden and Parking
output.description:
This well-maintained semi-detached house, built in the 1990s, offers approximately 195 m² of comfortable living space. The exterior features a classic brick facade complemented by a small front garden and a private driveway, enhancing convenience and curb appeal. 

Inside, the living room presents a transitional style with tile flooring and a fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The open-plan layout extends seamlessly into the dining area, with double doors providing direct access to the south-facing rear garden.

The kitchen is designed with traditional wood cabinetry and a tile splashback, equipped with a freestanding range and a breakfast nook, combining functionality with a cozy, informal dining space. 

The private rear garden includes a lawn and a patio, both oriented southwards, ensuring ample sunlight throughout the day. Additional features of the property include parking space and storage facilities. Energy passport: class to be confirmed.
